edit.statement: 'Is the plural of' is inverse functional: a singular noun has at most one plural form.
edit.subject: plural_of
edit.original: 'Is the plural of' is not inverse functional: a singular noun can have more than one plural form.
edit.scope: How many different plural forms one English noun can have.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is the plural of' (from plural forms to singular nouns) inverse functional, so that each singular noun has only one plural form?

En inglés, 'cacti' es el plural de 'cactus', y 'cactuses' también es el plural de 'cactus'. ¿Se deduce que 'cacti' y 'cactuses' son la misma palabra?
